verdict.rationale: Speaker diarization labels each segment of the transcript with its speaker, so the docs show segment-level structure rather than a plain text blob. The published OpenAPI spec indicates a structured, machine-readable API. However, nothing in the pack documents confidence values or shows the JSON response shape. Missing for 10: documented confidence scores (word or segment level), an explicit JSON response schema with utterances/words and timestamps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
